It was a pleasure seeing you today. My name is Dr. Jeffrey Jenks and you can contact me if you have any questions. The clinic number is 619-471-9250.
As discussed, I don't think any of those small lesions on your right arm are concerning.
I have placed another referral to Audiology, please call the number provided to schedule an appointment.
